audit_events_versions.name: audit_events_versions
audit_events_versions.value: ("hims"."audit_events"."before_version" IS NULL OR "hims"."audit_events"."before_version" > 0) AND ("hims"."audit_events"."after_version" IS NULL OR "hims"."audit_events"."after_version" > 0)

patient_age_identity.name: patient_age_identity
patient_age_identity.value: (("hims"."patients"."date_of_birth" is not null) <> ("hims"."patients"."age_years_at_registration" is not null)) or ("hims"."patients"."identity_status"='TEMPORARY' and "hims"."patients"."date_of_birth" is null and "hims"."patients"."age_years_at_registration" is null)

room_stay_cursor_boundary.name: room_stay_cursor_boundary
room_stay_cursor_boundary.value: "hims"."room_stays"."last_reconciled_at" is null or ("hims"."room_stays"."last_reconciled_at" >= "hims"."room_stays"."started_at" and ("hims"."room_stays"."ended_at" is null or "hims"."room_stays"."last_reconciled_at" <= "hims"."room_stays"."ended_at"))

pharmacy_stock_nonnegative.name: pharmacy_stock_nonnegative
pharmacy_stock_nonnegative.value: "hims"."pharmacy_batches"."available_quantity" >= 0 and ("hims"."pharmacy_batches"."reorder_threshold" is null or "hims"."pharmacy_batches"."reorder_threshold" >= 0) and "hims"."pharmacy_batches"."quantity_scale" between 0 and 6

pharmacy_movement_kind.name: pharmacy_movement_kind
pharmacy_movement_kind.value: ("hims"."pharmacy_movements"."kind" = 'RECEIPT' and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."quantity">0 and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."admission_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."order_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."original_issue_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."purpose" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."charge_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."reversal_id" is null) or ("hims"."pharmacy_movements"."kind" = 'ADJUSTMENT' and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."quantity"<>0 and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."admission_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."order_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."original_issue_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."purpose" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."charge_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."reversal_id" is null) or ("hims"."pharmacy_movements"."kind" = 'ISSUE' and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."quantity"<0 and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."admission_id" is not null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."order_id" is not null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."purpose" in ('WARD','TAKE_HOME') and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."charge_id" is not null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."original_issue_id" is null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."reversal_id" is null) or ("hims"."pharmacy_movements"."kind" = 'RETURN' and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."quantity">0 and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."admission_id" is not null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."order_id" is not null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."purpose" in ('WARD','TAKE_HOME') and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."charge_id" is not null and "hims"."pharmacy_movements"."original_issue_id" is not null)

insurance_decision_money.name: insurance_decision_money
insurance_decision_money.value: "hims"."insurance_decisions"."approved_paise">=0 and "hims"."insurance_decisions"."co_pay_bps" between 0 and 10000 and ("hims"."insurance_decisions"."status" not in ('PENDING','REJECTED') or "hims"."insurance_decisions"."approved_paise"=0)

insurance_transfer_source.name: insurance_transfer_source
insurance_transfer_source.value: ("hims"."insurance_transfer_resolutions"."decision_id" is not null) <> ("hims"."insurance_transfer_resolutions"."conversion_id" is not null)

clearance_gate_role.name: clearance_gate_role
clearance_gate_role.value: ("hims"."clearance_seals"."gate"='DOCTOR' and "hims"."clearance_seals"."role"='DOCTOR') or ("hims"."clearance_seals"."gate"='PHARMACY' and "hims"."clearance_seals"."role"='PHARMACY') or ("hims"."clearance_seals"."gate"='NURSING' and "hims"."clearance_seals"."role"='NURSE') or ("hims"."clearance_seals"."gate"='BILLING' and "hims"."clearance_seals"."role" in ('ADMIN','BILLING'))

exception_evidence_role.name: exception_evidence_role
exception_evidence_role.value: ("hims"."exception_evidence"."kind" in ('PHYSICAL_EXIT','TRANSFER_HANDOVER','RETURN_HANDOVER') and "hims"."exception_evidence"."role"='NURSE' and "hims"."exception_evidence"."shift_id" is not null) or ("hims"."exception_evidence"."kind" not in ('PHYSICAL_EXIT','TRANSFER_HANDOVER','RETURN_HANDOVER') and "hims"."exception_evidence"."role"='DOCTOR')

identified_patient_age.name: identified_patient_age
identified_patient_age.value: ("hims"."patient_identifications"."date_of_birth" is not null) <> ("hims"."patient_identifications"."age_years_at_registration" is not null)

identified_patient_values.name: identified_patient_values
identified_patient_values.value: "hims"."patient_identifications"."sex" in ('FEMALE','MALE','OTHER','UNKNOWN') and ("hims"."patient_identifications"."age_years_at_registration" is null or "hims"."patient_identifications"."age_years_at_registration" between 0 and 130) and "hims"."patient_identifications"."version">0
